gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Mon Jun 15 23:55:06 GMT 2026
ADDED i2: Tests for {@link GeohashUtils}, the geohash encode/decode helper.
ADDED i3: Tolerance used when comparing decoded latitude/longitude values.
ADDED i4: When both the requested width and height errors are moderate (7 degrees), a short geohash length of 3 is enough to satisfy them.
ADDED i5: A zero height error can never be met by any geohash cell, so the lookup falls back to the maximum precision (24).
ADDED i6: Refining a geohash by one level yields one child for each of the 32 base-32 characters.
ADDED i7: Decoding a geohash returns the centre point of the encoded cell. Upper-case letters and unrecognised characters are tolerated by the decoder.
ADDED i8: Hash lengths beyond the supported maximum index out of the internal lookup tables, surfacing as an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
ADDED i10: Encoding a latitude/longitude pair produces the expected 12-character geohash string (the default precision).
